products.name: Deposition Assignment Readiness
products.product: A focused court reporting deposition scheduling workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent court-reporting agencies and deposition coordination teams
products.problem: Date, time zone, location or link, reporter, videographer, interpreter, exhibits, contacts, delivery needs, and changes flow across email threads.
products.valueProposition: Turns court reporting deposition scheduling into a visible operating queue so every assignment has current logistics, qualified resources, contacts, and delivery expectations acknowledged.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
